cases.title: a request without other votes gets a temporary vote
a request with the temporary votes of every representative gets a permanent vote
an hour later, a representative that has not voted refuses the bare block but gives a recovery vote against permanent votes
a recovery vote carries no fee, while a normal temporary vote carries a zero fee
a recovery vote on blocks that end in a fee block skips the fee checks
a recovery vote is refused when the permanent votes weigh exactly a quarter of the total
a recovery vote is given when the permanent votes weigh three quarters of the total
an empty list of other votes takes the recovery path with no weight
a request without blocks is refused
a request whose first block is a fee block is refused
a quote on no blocks is given
a permanent request with only other representatives' temporary votes is refused
a permanent request that offers our own permanent vote is refused
a recovery request that includes our own permanent vote is refused
a request that offers the same vote twice is refused
a request that offers two votes of one issuer is refused
a request whose other votes cover other blocks is refused
a request that offers a quote as a supporting vote is refused
a permanent request that comes with a quote is refused
a quote from another issuer, on other blocks or on another number of blocks is refused
a temporary vote on a matching quote copies the quote's fee
